verdict.rationale: PostHog's feature-flag docs cover creating flags, setting release conditions, scheduling changes, and managing flags from CI or MCP clients. Nothing in the pack documents an approval or change-request gate before production flag changes go live. Scheduling a change is not an approval workflow, and the 'review pull requests' item concerns AI-generated code fixes, not flag governance.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can require approvals or change requests before production flag changes go live
